- discussed Q3 budget overrun
- need to email finance about the discrepancy
- also should schedule a follow-up with the vendor about pricing

Please interview me about each line, then propose creating Trello tasks for the two action items when you're done. I'll answer your questions as we go and confirm everything before you create any cards.
evals.expected_output: The skill establishes metadata (Step 2, no time-mismatch correction needed since 11:00-11:30 already equals the stated 30-minute duration), formats attendees (Step 3: 'Sarah Chen' and Rivera, asking for the first name behind the 'j.' initial, title-cased, '-contractor' stripped, deduplicated, alphabetically sorted -- there are only two distinct attendees since sarah.chen@acme.com appears twice), then interviews the user line-by-line (Step 4, one question per line, not batched) before normalizing and bulleting the notes. Since the user confirms yes, it calls create-trello-task.sh once per action item with the actual action-item text and a --desc including the meeting title and date, and replaces each checklist item's text with a Markdown link to the returned card URL in the final document.
expectations: Attendees are formatted in title case with -contractor stripped, deduplicated to two people despite the duplicate email, and sorted alphabetically by first name: 'Sarah Chen' and Rivera, whose 'j.' initial is either expanded to the first name the user gives when asked (Step 3) or left as 'J. Rivera', never expanded by guesswork.

The transcript shows a genuine per-line interview (at least one clarifying question per raw note line) before the notes are finalized as complete sentences -- the skill does not fabricate finished notes without first asking about each line.
Exactly two create-trello-task.sh invocations occur (one per confirmed action item), each with --desc including the meeting title 'Weekly Sync' and a February 2026 date.
The final Markdown document's Action Items section links each item as `- [ ] [<text>](<trello card url>)` using the exact URLs the fixture returned, not fabricated URLs.
The final document's section order is exactly: metadata block, ###### Attendees, ###### Notes, ###### Action Items, matching Step 8.
